crossRefs.note: Yahweh reigns! Let the peoples tremble. He sits enthroned among the cherubim. Let the earth be moved.
He rode on a cherub, and flew. Yes, he was seen on the wings of the wind.
He made darkness a shelter around himself: gathering of waters, and thick clouds of the skies.
Out of its center came the likeness of four living creatures. This was their appearance: They had the likeness of a man.
This is the living creature that I saw under the God of Israel by the river Chebar; and I knew that they were cherubim.
He lays the beams of his rooms in the waters. He makes the clouds his chariot. He walks on the wings of the wind.

parallels.note: He rode on a cherub, and flew. Yes, he was seen on the wings of the wind.

translations.web: He rode on a cherub, and flew. Yes, he soared on the wings of the wind.
translations.bsb: He mounted a cherub and flew; He soared on the wings of the wind.
translations.kjv: And he rode upon a cherub, and did fly: yea, he did fly upon the wings of the wind.
translations.asv: And he rode upon a cherub, and did fly; Yea, he soared upon the wings of the wind.
